name: ScopedLocking
summary: Ensures that a lock is acquired when control enters a scope and released automatically when control leaves it, by whatever path.

reference.author: Douglas Schmidt, Michael Stal, Hans Rohnert, Frank Buschmann

roles.name: Guard
roles.summary: The class whose construction acquires the lock and whose disposal releases it. Every way out of the scope releases it — a return, a thrown exception, a branch added next year by somebody who never read this class — which is the one thing an explicit release on each path cannot promise.

roles.name: Lock
roles.summary: The lock the guard manages. Annotating it claims that this lock is taken through the guard and never directly, so a bare acquire anywhere else in the type is the breach rather than a matter of style.
